## Checklist

- [ ] My change is small and focused on one topic.
- [ ] Commands and examples were tested or checked against official documentation.
- [ ] No passwords, API keys, tokens, connection strings, SAS tokens or private keys are included.
- [ ] No real subscription IDs, tenant IDs, public IPs, hostnames or personal information are included. Placeholders are used instead.
- [ ] Screenshots, if any, are cropped or redacted.
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/BlakerAtchley/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/BlakerAtchley/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
